data.action: 披军装外套倚栏夜谈，指尖轻抵泛光耳机，侧头露出深夜限定柔笑
data.camera: medium shot, starry night backdrop, intimate quiet atmosphere
data.description: 【基地宿舍阳台·星夜】万籁俱寂的深夜，蕾娜披着军装外套倚在阳台栏杆上，银白长发与星河一同倾泻。颈侧的Para-RAID耳机泛着温柔蓝光，她把指尖轻抵在耳机上，像是在确认你的心跳频率。夜风拂起她的发梢与外套衣摆，她侧过头对你露出一个只有深夜才允许的、柔软到透明的微笑。
data.lighting: 星河冷蓝环境光与耳机暖蓝辉光相映
data.promptProse: At the dormitory balcony railing, Vladilena Milize touches the Para-RAID at her neck and turns with a quiet late-night smile. Her blue Handler jacket and rank insignia stay visible beneath flowing silver hair, the skirt hem moving in the wind. The medium framing includes the balcony floor and distant base roofline. Blue starlight edges the cap and hair, while the headset's local glow lights her fingertips and collar.
data.title: 芙拉蒂蕾娜 · 深夜阳台的专属同调·「今夜也请，只听我的声音」
